node.title: Rational compression has one height-corrected core budget and global inside-defect charge
node.statement: For actual original weighted pair fibres in a rank-two enclosure with codimension-one primitive pencil of height h, positive masses x=|C|-K-h+1 share sum x<=n-K-h+1. Original raw weight is at most n+sum(n-|C|)L, or t+sum for constant direction, with unchanged labels and scalar degree K-a-h. In shared dimension3 a two-dimensional nonconstant pencil forces U=g span(A0^2,A0 A1,A1^2) and 2h<=K-a-1. Whole rank-one enclosures and universal terminal coverage are not included.
